name: pi-maestro-mobile
description: Maestro Mobile Host — PC 端常驻服务：Pi agent 会话桥 + Monitor telemetry 投影 + 移动端 WS/HTTP 服务

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @maestro-mobile/mobile-sdk build && bash scripts/vendor-shared.sh && npx tsc --noEmit; rc=$?; bash scripts/cleanup-vendor.sh; exit $rc
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @maestro-mobile/mobile-sdk build && pnpm --filter @maestro-mobile/shared build && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @maestro-mobile/mobile-sdk build && pnpm --filter @maestro-mobile/shared build && vitest run --coverage
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm --filter @maestro-mobile/mobile-sdk build && pnpm --filter @maestro-mobile/shared build && bash build.sh && vitest run
